title: Cameras and sensors
description: Device registry, events and live view.

live.notConfiguredHint: Add a live view address to the device card.
live.notInstalled: This camera is not installed yet.
live.failedHint: The address is not working, or this browser cannot play the format.
live.insecureHint: This address uses http, which a secure app cannot embed. Open the stream separately, or give the gateway an https address.
live.gatewayTitle: Live view is not connected yet
live.gatewayBody: Browsers cannot play RTSP directly. Once a stream gateway such as MediaMTX runs at the farm, put its address on each camera's card.
live.plannedBody_one: The {{count}} registered camera is still planned. Once it is installed and a stream gateway is connected, its picture shows here.
live.plannedBody_other: All {{count}} registered cameras are still planned. Once they are installed and a stream gateway is connected, their pictures show here.
live.morePlanned_one: {{count}} more camera is planned and not installed yet.
live.morePlanned_other: {{count}} more cameras are planned and not installed yet.

plan.archive: A 30-day local archive stays at the farm. Clips of important events go to the cloud.

purpose.barn: Counting animals, inactivity, lambing, trough state
purpose.feed_store: Stock in and out, signs of fire
purpose.gate: Vehicles, strangers, movement outside working hours

devices.name: Name
devices.emptyBody: Add a camera or sensor to the registry.
devices.deleteBody: "{{name}}" will leave the registry. Its events stay in the journal.
devices.streamUrlHint: A user name and password are taken out of the address and stored encrypted.

devices.onvifUrlHint: Enter it without a user name or password.
